# Washington State Military Department

> Official website for Washington State Military Department, providing information on the National Guard, emergency management, disaster response, and military careers.

The Washington State Military Department oversees the Washington National Guard (Army and Air National Guard), emergency management operations, and disaster response coordination across Washington State. The site serves military personnel, veterans, job seekers, and emergency management stakeholders.

## Key Topics

- Washington National Guard
- Emergency Management
- Disaster Response
- FEMA Assistance
- Military Careers
- National Guard Education
- Veterans Benefits
- Disaster Preparedness
- Camp Murray
- Washington Army National Guard
- Washington Air National Guard
- Public Assistance
- Emergency Logistics
- Transition Assistance
- 56th Theater Information Operations Group

## Organization & Mission

- [Home](https://m.mil.wa.gov): Homepage for Washington State Military Department, National Guard, and Emergency Management
- [National Guard](https://m.mil.wa.gov/national-guard): Overview of Washington National Guard organization and mission
- [56th Theater Information Operations Group](https://m.mil.wa.gov/56th-theater-information-operations-group): Information about 56th Theater Information Operations Group military unit

## Military Careers & Human Resources

- [Job Opportunities](https://m.mil.wa.gov/job-opportunities): Job opportunities and career recruitment for Washington National Guard
- [Education](https://m.mil.wa.gov/education): National Guard education benefits including GI Bill and tuition assistance
- [Transition Assistance Advisor](https://m.mil.wa.gov/transition-assistance-advisor): Transition assistance and veterans benefits counseling for service members

## Emergency Management & Disaster Response

- [Preliminary Damage Assessment](https://m.mil.wa.gov/preliminary-damage-assessment): Guide to preliminary damage assessment process for FEMA disaster assistance
- [Logistics and Resources](https://m.mil.wa.gov/logistics-and-resources): Emergency logistics, resource requests, and mutual aid coordination guide
- [Grants Flood Mitigation Assistance](https://m.mil.wa.gov/grants-flood-mitigation-assistance): FEMA flood mitigation assistance grants and application information
- [Landslide](https://m.mil.wa.gov/landslide): Landslide hazards and disaster preparedness information for Washington
- [911 Public Service Announcements](https://m.mil.wa.gov/911psa): 911 public service announcements and emergency dispatch education campaigns

## Contact & Support Services

- [Public Assistance Contacts](https://m.mil.wa.gov/public-assistance-contacts): Contact directory for public assistance and emergency management staff
- [Map Your Neighborhood Contact Information](https://m.mil.wa.gov/myn-contact-information): Map Your Neighborhood contact directory for emergency management agencies

## News & Features

- [How would businesses survive after the Big One hits?](https://m.mil.wa.gov/news/how-would-businesses-survive-after-the-big-one-hits): Article on earthquake preparedness and business continuity planning
- [JTAC's train in close air support](https://m.mil.wa.gov/news/jtacs-train-in-close-air-support): News article about Joint Terminal Attack Controller training for Air National Guard
- [Deputy Legal Counsel for the Washington National Guard Honored by Department of Defense with prestigious Seven Seals Awards](https://m.mil.wa.gov/news/deputy-legal-counsel-for-the-washington-national-guard-honored-by-department-of-defense-with-prestigious-seven-seals-awards): News article about Maj. Alex Straub receiving Seven Seals Award
